files.review: Approved. White tee on a wooden hanger in a light wood wardrobe; no people, no logos.

files.creator: Bennie Bates
files.review: Approved. Plain tees in cream, navy, yellow and green on a white rail against orange; no people, no visible labels. Strong match for the flash palette.
